name: Hazel's Brewmaster
oracle_text:
Menace
Whenever this creature enters or attacks, exile up to one target card from a graveyard and create a Food token.
Foods you control have all activated abilities of all creature cards exiled with this creature.
blocked_sentences: Foods you control have all activated abilities of all creature cards exiled with this creature.

needs.what: a static ability that gives each permanent matching its `affects` filter (here Food artifacts you control: `subtypes: ["Food"]`, `controller: you`) every activated ability (mana abilities included) printed on the cards matching an `exiled_with: self` selector narrowed by type (here creature cards), read live from exile so the set grows as the enters/attacks trigger exiles more cards, and ending when the source leaves the battlefield
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `grant_ability` static only hands over a fixed ability written in the card's own `grantable_abilities` by index, so it cannot borrow abilities from whatever cards happen to be exiled; `imprint_characteristics` reads an exiled card but copies only power, toughness and creature types, never abilities; `exiled_with` exists only as an effect selector key, not in `static_filter_keys` or `static_affects_filter_keys`
